name: mustr
description: Clan management system — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + React. A rewrite of the 2003 PHP original.

scripts.build: npm run db:bundle && tsc --noEmit && vite build

cloudflare.label: mustr — community tools for gaming orgs

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A password **you invent** (letters and numbers only — avoid `+ / =`) that unlocks the one-time setup wizard the first time your site loads, so nobody can claim your site before you do. You paste it once, then you're done. Generate a safe one with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A long random string (letters and numbers) used to sign login/session cookies — keep it secret. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

DB.description: Your site's database (Cloudflare D1). Created automatically — nothing to enter. The schema builds itself on first run.

MEDIA.description: File storage for uploaded images (Cloudflare R2). Created automatically — nothing to enter.
